code: const ensureDemo = (id) => ssp.topologyTool.getGraph(id) || ssp.topologyTool.createGraph({ id, layers: [{ id: 'A_1F', label: 'A楼1层', order: 1, elevation: 0 }, { id: 'A_2F', label: 'A楼2层', order: 2, elevation: 4 }], nodes: [{ id: 'entry-door', layerId: 'A_1F', position: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, kind: 'DOOR' }, { id: 'hydrant-a1', layerId: 'A_1F', position: { x: 4, y: 0, z: 0 }, kind: 'FACILITY', subtype: 'HYDRANT' }, { id: 'stair-a1', layerId: 'A_1F', position: { x: 8, y: 0, z: 0 }, connectorId: 'stair:north-01', kind: 'STAIR' }, { id: 'stair-a2', layerId: 'A_2F', position: { x: 8, y: 4, z: 0 }, connectorId: 'stair:north-01', kind: 'STAIR' }, { id: 'fire-a2', layerId: 'A_2F', position: { x: 12, y: 4, z: 0 }, kind: 'INCIDENT', subtype: 'FIRE' }], edges: [{ id: 'edge-entry-hydrant', source: 'entry-door', target: 'hydrant-a1', relation: 'LINK', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL' }, { id: 'edge-hydrant-stair-a1', source: 'hydrant-a1', target: 'stair-a1', relation: 'LINK', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL' }, { id: 'edge-stair-a1-a2', source: 'stair-a1', target: 'stair-a2', relation: 'CONNECTOR', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL', mode: 'STAIR' }, { id: 'edge-stair-a2-fire', source: 'stair-a2', target: 'fire-a2', relation: 'LINK', direction: 'BIDIRECTIONAL' }] }); const graphId = params.graphId === undefined ? ensureDemo('topology_demo_get_graph').id : params.graphId; const graph = ssp.topologyTool.getGraph(graphId); if (!graph) return { found: false, id: graphId }; return { found: true, id: graph.id, routingRevision: graph.routingRevision, visualRevision: graph.visualRevision, layers: graph.layers.map((layer) => layer.id), nodes: graph.nodes.map((node) => ({ id: node.id, layerId: node.layerId, kind: node.kind || null, subtype: node.subtype || null, connectorId: node.connectorId || null })), edges: graph.edges.map((edge) => ({ id: edge.id, source: edge.source, target: edge.target, relation: edge.relation, length: edge.length, traversable: edge.routingState.traversable })) };
